entries.clue: Older student handed a badge and a small slice of authority
Small hole that lets the air out and the swearing in
Small toothed wheel, or a lowly worker in a vast machine
Spread of grazing land where cattle are raised and rounded up
Arena contest of bull riding and roping, won for a prize buckle
What you grip to steer, or a moustache curled at the ends
Rapid free run down the far side of a long hill
Morning roll-call list where each name gets a tick
Two-seater machine for a pair, or working closely in step
Rail-fenced pen where horses are held before the ride out
Group of young singers rehearsing for the carol service
Yard spell of shrieks and chased footballs, ended by a whistle
Bare metal hoop that a tyre is stretched onto
